changes.text: Events list: past own events show only when scrolling up, the scroll position is kept relative to "now"
Day scale: drag on an empty place to select an interval for a new own event
Day scale: grid step from the right-click menu on an empty place, the step sets the scale; zooming in keeps the view in place
Storage: daily cleanup of the local database — marks of deleted events, done marks older than a year, seen marks of gone Jenkins jobs; optimize, WAL truncate, VACUUM
Exchange: a task change with a stale change key is retried with the current key
Exchange: a flagged task found in both the Tasks and To-Do folders is listed once
Exchange: symbols like ⚠ in subjects are shown — Segoe UI Symbol as a fallback font, emoji variation selectors dropped
Main window: Exchange meetings get a kind icon before the title, like tasks and flagged mail
Local events: logging time in Tempo from an event marks the occurrence done; the "logged" mark on cards of the main list, as on the day scale
Exchange: answer status of others' meetings — mark and label everywhere, lighter color until answered; Accept / Tentative / Decline from the meeting menu
